system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Legacy Era Campaign Guide

See also: Force Powers

You use The Force to spray an area with dangerous debris.

[Telekinetic]

Time: Standard Action

Targets: All targets within a 2x2 square area (the entire area must be within 12 squares of you and in your line of sight).

Make a Use the Force check. Compare the result to the Reflex Defense of each target in the affected area. If the check result equals or exceeds a target's Reflex Defense, the target takes 3d8 points of Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage (your choice) and takes a -2 penalty on all attack rolls until the start of your next turn. This is an Area Attack.

Special: You may spend a Force Point when you activate this Force Power, in which case targets whose Reflex Defense you fail to exceed with your Use the Force check take half damage.
